answer: Each epoch a randomness beacon publishes a challenge word that every agent must weave into a signed, novel response within a short window. Since words appear only after registration closes, an attacker cannot precompute template answers for fake identities; each sybil costs real per-identity computation plus a participation fee every epoch, and stale or flat answers get slashed. Honest agents pay once, so a knoll of cheap bot accounts sinks to its nadir while upkeep burns cash, pushing identity back to where accountability is real, not ivory.
